name: Deadlock
notes: Named as a Steam game without a profile is, so that its logs and its Windows environment stay where they were before it had one. Source 2, Direct3D 11. The game is shown the display as it is: Thalles asked that speed come from Macron's, Wine's and DXMT's code and not from a smaller picture (2026-11-20). On a MacBook Air M3 (1920x1243 points) that is 75 frames a second on the title screen and 53 to 55 in the practice map while the Mac is cool, with 32 ms from a frame's start to the end of its GPU work; the GPU works 22 ms on a frame. v0.5.0-rc8 showed the game a 1098x711 screen on the base chips (renderPixels 780000): 74 to 77 in the practice map and 23 to 24 ms, with a soft picture. That is still there for whoever wants it, as the launch option MACRON_RENDER_PIXELS=780000 %command% (Wine patch 0017; docs/perf/latency.md, 'Deadlock on the M3').
